evidence.quote: I remain willing to raise the target range for the federal funds rate at a future meeting should the incoming data indicate that progress on inflation has stalled or reversed.
However, we are still not yet at the point where it is appropriate to lower the policy rate, and I continue to see a number of upside risks to inflation.
I expect inflation to remain elevated for some time.
Despite some further rebalancing between supply and demand, the labor market remains tight.
could add momentum to demand, stalling any further progress or even causing inflation to reaccelerate.
my baseline outlook continues to be that inflation will decline further with the policy rate held steady.

parsed.rationale: Bowman emphasizes elevated inflation, multiple upside inflation risks, and willingness to hike, while acknowledging eventual cuts only conditionally. The monetary section is hawkish, and the rest of the speech covers bank regulation.
